ZXi RKT Drivers deliver scorchingly fast ball speeds and unmatched directional stability with a completely new, harmonic system. This is not an evolution. It is a complete reimagination, in relentless pursuit of what’s possible. Three completely new Drivers. Years of obsession. One uncompromising standard.

RKT Face = VR-Titanium + i-FLEX + Rebound Frame + Variable Roll Design

Our completely new ACOUSTICORE chassis feature AI-optimized internal rib structures, precisely tuned to refine the acoustic character of every ZXi RKT model.

Advanced simulation, Modal analysis. And a lightweight carbon fiber crown guided the development process, allowing our engineers to hone these sounds.

The result is a crisp, controlled sound at impact.

settings.heading: LASER FACE MILLING
settings.text: A new milling design makes the face easier to see and easier to align with the target, while also helping to stabilize spin and add forgiveness in wet conditions.

settings.heading: CARBON FIBER CROWN
settings.text: A lightweight, carbon fiber crown design allows for mass to be positioned elsewhere, while also helping to improve each Driver’s sound.

settings.heading: PLAYER-FOCUSED ADJUSTABILITY
settings.text: Different weighting designs on each model plus adjustable hosels allow for fine-tuned launch and spin performance for every player.
The lineup
FIND YOUR ZXi RKT

The all-new stable of Srixon ZXi RKT Woods features purposely crafted models across drivers, fairway woods, and hybrids. Built with explosive speed to meet the long game needs of tour players, professionals, and amateurs alike.

settings.heading: ZXi RKT
settings.text: The ZXi RKT Driver combines fast, forgiveness, and feel with high ball speed and high MOI while keeping spin relatively low. Adjustable Sole Weights in the heel and toe can be calibrated to promote your preferred trajectory.

settings.heading: ZXi RKT LS
settings.text: The ZXi RKT LS Driver’s advanced low spin profile is built for aggressive players seeking distance and a more piercing trajectory thanks to its deeper RKT Face technology. Adjustable Sole Weights in the front and rear allow you to optimize your preferred spin characteristics.

settings.heading: ZXi RKT MAX
settings.text: The ZXi RKT MAX Driver is Srixon’s highest MOI Driver to date, featuring an easy swing feel and heightened forgiveness in a sharp, high-performance profile. An Adjustable Sole Weight placed exclusively low in the rear allows you to choose your preferred swing weight and maximize MOI benefits for total confidence on the tee box.

settings.heading: ZXi RKT MAX WOMEN'S
settings.text: The ZXi RKT MAX Women’s Driver is Srixon’s highest MOI Driver to date, featuring an easy swing feel and heightened forgiveness in a sharp, high-performance profile. An Adjustable Sole Weight placed exclusively low in the rear allows you to choose your preferred swing weight and maximize MOI benefits for total confidence on the tee box.

settings.heading: ZXi RKT FAIRWAY WOOD
settings.text: ZXi RKT Fairway Woods share the same advanced ball speed architecture as the Drivers, anchored by the new RKT Face. For the first time, an Adjustable Sole Weight and Adjustable Hosel Sleeve work together as one system, allowing precise calibration of launch, swing weight, and distance gapping. Refined in every contour and validated on tour, this design represents our most adaptable Fairway Woods to date.

settings.heading: ZXi RKT W FAIRWAY WOOD
settings.text: ZXi RKT Women’s Fairway Woods share the same advanced ball speed architecture as the Drivers, anchored by the new RKT Face. For the first time, an Adjustable Sole Weight and Adjustable Hosel Sleeve work together as one system, allowing precise calibration of launch, swing weight, and distance gapping. Refined in every contour and validated on tour, this design represents our most adaptable Fairway Woods to date.

settings.heading: ZXi RKT HYBRID
settings.text: The all-new ZXi RKT Hybrids are built on the same advanced ball speed platform as the Drivers, powered by the new RKT Face. For the first time, an Adjustable Sole Weight and Adjustable Hosel Sleeve work together as one system, allowing precise calibration of swing weight and distance gapping to fit your game. Validated on tour and shaped for control, the compact head design delivers stability through impact. Optimized loft promotes confident launch from tight lies, deep rough, or fairway bunkers.

Technologies
ZXI Woods, Technology.

settings.heading: i-FLEX
settings.text: This optimized face thickness pattern produces more efficient energy transfer at impact. The added strength of interior i-FLEX face structure allows our engineers to thin the face, increasing ball speed.

settings.heading: REBOUND FRAME
settings.text: An entirely unique system that amplifies energy transfer at impact by utilizing two flex zones, instead of just one. Rebound Frame maximizes flex across the face and body to increase power, ball speed, and ultimately, distance.

settings.heading: VARIABLE ROLL DESIGN
settings.text: This brand-new roll design is optimized to maximize accuracy on misses across the face, especially in the high toe.

settings.heading: CARBON FIBER CROWN
settings.text: The 3W and 3+W use a strong, lightweight carbon crown, positioning mass low and maximizing COR.

settings.heading: TOUR-DRIVEN CHASSIS
settings.text: Through rigorous prototyping and on-tour testing, R&D engineers aligned with pro staff to create significant shaping updates on every ZXi RKT clubhead that fit the eyes and performance needs of the best players in the world.

settings.heading: PLAYER-FOCUSED ADJUSTABILITY
settings.text: Different weighting designs on each model plus adjustable hosels allow for fine-tuning launch and spin performance for every player.
